sql_query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)::integer AS customers_with_multiple_purchases
FROM (
  SELECT
    LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10) AS customer_unique_id_10,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10)
  HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1
) t;
